rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for dealing effectively with a difficult situation, task, or demand.

example.english: This report is so difficult, but I can cope with it.
example.traditional: 呢份報告咁難，我都應付到。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 gam3 naan4 ngo5 dou1 jing1 fu6 dou2

rows.note: Use this colloquial phrase when stressing that someone can manage or get the difficult thing under control.

example.english: Can you cope with all these jobs on your own?
example.traditional: 咁多單嘢，你一個人搞得掂呀？
example.jyutping: gam3 do1 daan1 je5 nei5 jat1 go3 jan4 gaau2 dak1 dim6 aa3

rows.note: Use this when coping means withstanding pressure, hardship, workload, or an unpleasant situation without being overwhelmed.

example.english: Even after staying up all night for several days, we can still cope.
example.traditional: 連續幾日通宵，我哋仲頂得住。
example.jyutping: lin4 zuk6 gei2 jat6 tung1 siu1 ngo5 dei6 zung6 ding2 dak1 zyu6
